funding_endpoint_convention: Actual terminal includes all persisted actual cash deltas; interior snapshots include funding events timestamp strictly<actualreceipt_ns, exact ties explicit UNKNOWNtiming; never residual-assigned
bounds: As-of actual receipt<=requested UTC boundary, source_quote_ns retained; window fillflow exact observed fill_epoch prefix difference
limitations: No counterfactual PNL or causal decomposition of compounding/TP/second entry/size; common timing deltas are observed comparisons only.
Year marked returns and entry-year cycle cohorts are different measurements; cycles spanning year are not force-split into trade cohorts.
Actual DD excursions use complete settled-grid highwater/maximumtrough/untilrecovery; intraminute and L2 unknown.
All reported prices/quantities/nativecash/funding are actual archived outputs; no new simulator.
Nonzero reserve path not supported without actual per-receipt reserve; script stops.
E4 timing/size reference only; old signed funding remains UNKNOWN, no rerun or optional invented attribution.

Interior asset marked pricePNL uses exported raw markclose; native observer uses instrument.make_price(close). Unexported native-rounded close can leave a bounded explicitly retained attribution residual, not funding/cash bridge; BTCtick0.1/SOLtick0.01 from frozen native_fixture.py.
